description: One medical provider: the law firms that named them, their case list, how those cases ended, and, for defense examiners, the kinds of findings they disputed and on which body regions (counts only).

purpose.description: One sentence on what you are trying to find out. Logged to improve the dataset; never returned.

name: get_provider

cases.description: Cases whose expert disclosures name the provider.

casesByYear.description: Cases counted by the year they were filed.

credential.description: The credential named in the filings. When the filings name none, or one outside the usual list, and the federal NPI registry finds the clinician exactly once, the credential the registry lists, e.g. "M.D.". "other" when the filings name a credential outside the usual list and the registry does not supply one. null when neither says.

byBodyRegion.description: Disputed findings counted by body region.

byKind.description: Disputed findings counted by kind of dispute.

disputes.description: Findings this examiner disputed in defense examinations; null when none were read.

docketNumbers.description: Docket numbers of the cases naming the provider, for get_case.

kind.description: clinician: a person; practice: a clinic, hospital or other organisation.

acceptedOffer.description: Accepted offers of compromise in cases closed from closedFrom to closedTo; most such cases close by withdrawal, which the court removes.

medianCents.description: Median amount in cents; null when n is 0.

p25Cents.description: Nearest-rank 25th percentile in cents; null when n is 0.

p75Cents.description: Nearest-rank 75th percentile in cents; null when n is 0.

closedFrom.description: First disposition date counted, inclusive. Outcome counts here cover only cases closed from closedFrom to closedTo, not all time.

closedTo.description: Last disposition date counted, inclusive: the dataset as-of date.

dispositions.description: Cases closed from closedFrom to closedTo, counted by disposition category. Counts only cases closed in the 330 days ending at the as-of date (closedFrom to closedTo): the court removes withdrawn cases about a year after withdrawal, so only the last ~11 months of closures are complete. A district last fetched before the as-of date contributes closures only up to its fetch date, a slightly shorter window; the closures it does contribute are still complete.

netVerdict.description: Every net jury verdict on record, not limited to closedFrom to closedTo: verdicts are not removed from the court website.

medianCents.description: Median amount in cents; null when n is 0.

p25Cents.description: Nearest-rank 25th percentile in cents; null when n is 0.

p75Cents.description: Nearest-rank 75th percentile in cents; null when n is 0.

retainingFirms.description: The lead firm on the provider's side in their cases, most frequent first.

name.description: Firm name; null when the firm is not in the dataset.

side.description: treating: named as the plaintiff's treating provider; defense_examiner: retained by the defense to examine the plaintiff.

specialty.description: The specialty named in the filings. When the filings name none and the federal NPI registry finds the clinician exactly once and, when the filings name a credential from the usual list, lists that same credential: the registry's primary taxonomy, e.g. Orthopaedic Surgery. null otherwise.

town.description: Town the provider practises in, when known.

contactUrl.description: Contact form for asking about more access.

limitReached.description: Present only past the daily profile limit.

resetsAt.description: When the limit resets: the next UTC midnight, ISO 8601.

title: Medical provider profile
